name: semantic-search-baseline
description: Smoke benchmark for the claude-flow semantic memory stack. Five short project-specific documents are seeded into the `benchmark` namespace; each query should rank its expected document first via cosine similarity on 384-dim ONNX embeddings.

documents.value: Camera uptime is computed from heartbeat events; cameras missing 3+ consecutive heartbeats are marked offline.
analytics_events.value for line_crossing and people_in/out is a cumulative counter on the camera; per-period totals require computing deltas between consecutive samples.
Hourly analytics rollups are exposed via REST API, server-sent events stream, and the emailed report; default window is 24h.
Production app runs as the AxisCameraUptime Windows service via NSSM, which forces NODE_ENV=production.
Local admin login uses JWT tokens with refresh; admin@axis.local was seeded as the default development account.

queries.query: how do I tell if a camera went down
queries.rationale: Query shares only the word `camera` with the top hit; semantic match comes from `heartbeat`/`offline` <-> `went down`.
Query has zero word overlap; semantic match comes from `line_crossing`/`people_in/out` <-> `entering and leaving`.

pass_criteria.rank_1_match: For every query, the top-scoring result key must equal `expected_top_key`.
pass_criteria.notes: Baseline scores are observation-only; embedding models and similarity normalization may shift them across versions. Track rank-1 match strictly; warn/fail on score drift only as a regression signal.
